Transfer

Transfer (dual list box) moves items between two lists. Useful for selecting subsets, managing permissions, or assigning roles.

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
function transferItems(transferId, direction) {
  var transfer = document.getElementById(transferId);
  var sourceList = transfer.querySelector('[data-panel="source"]');
  var targetList = transfer.querySelector('[data-panel="target"]');
  var fromList = direction === 'right' ? sourceList : targetList;
  var toList = direction === 'right' ? targetList : sourceList;
  fromList.querySelectorAll('.zak-checkbox:checked').forEach(function (cb) {
    if (cb.disabled) return;
    var label = cb.closest('label');
    var clone = label.cloneNode(true);
    clone.querySelector('input').checked = false;
    label.remove();
    toList.appendChild(clone);
  });
}

function filterTransferList(input, transferId, panel) {
  var list = document.querySelector('#' + transferId + ' [data-panel="' + panel + '"]');
  var q = input.value.toLowerCase();
  list.querySelectorAll('label').forEach(function (label) {
    label.style.display = label.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

function toggleAll(checkbox, transferId, panel) {
  var list = document.querySelector('#' + transferId + ' [data-panel="' + panel + '"]');
  list.querySelectorAll('.zak-checkbox').forEach(function (cb) { cb.checked = checkbox.checked; });
}
